pre_freeze_review.how: Two independent read-only reviewers, one lens each - the corrected validity condition and the corpus fact behind it, and whether the frozen reader would read an honest run. Both recomputed from the data rather than reading numbers off artifacts. Neither could write to the repository.
pre_freeze_review.status: complete; findings applied before the freeze
pre_freeze_review.the_finding_that_justified_the_review: A THIRD distinct defect that would have voided an honest run, and a third distinct cause. The reader required an integer fit_info.n_iter from all eleven arms. sklearn's DummyClassifier exposes no n_iter_ and no get_depth, and DecisionTreeClassifier exposes get_depth/get_n_leaves but no n_iter_, so run_recipe_search.fit_info() banks {} for the two dummy baselines and {depth, n_leaves} for the two tree baselines - never an iteration count. Four VOID clauses, on the four arms the run's own floor clause depends on. The reviewer proved it by building a faithful real-run artifact from the RUNNER's code and running the frozen reader on it, and proved that fixing two lines was the entire distance between VOID and a verdict. With the n_iter clause alone removed the reader then crashed: at_iteration_cap computed None >= 0 for the same four arms.
pre_freeze_review.the_reproduction_control_quantified: Asked for a number rather than an argument: the 8 duplicated rows in the 100000-row reproduction block each have exactly one twin among the 260000 evaluation rows, so the largest possible memorisation effect on the banked 0.1965 is 8/260000 = 3.0769e-5, which is 0.62 percent of the 0.005 reproduction tolerance and cannot move the fourth decimal place. The clause's own 38452 rows have zero exposure: no extension row is byte-identical to any of the 1300000 builder rows.
pre_freeze_review.what_the_reviewers_checked_and_found_cor: Independently recomputed and confirmed: the 9 duplicate chunk pairs and their per-pair row counts summing to 64; the 44496/48016 pair at 26 of 26; all four expected collision counts (0, 8, 2, 0) against the blocks 0021 seals; the row counts 100000/26346/20817/26346 and chunk counts 37108/19413/1029/1029; all seven sealed index hashes and all eight corpus array hashes; the cache X hash; every reader literal - CORPUS, EXT, FIT, all 32 PARTITION keys, both chunk layouts expanding exactly to their arrays, PROTOCOL and RECIPES and all seven recipe hashes; all eleven fingerprints agreeing between the runner's call and the reader's recomputation; STAGE_OF and ROWS_OF against all four dispatch sites; that every top-level, scores-file and record key the reader reads is one the runner writes; that the collision clause voids in BOTH directions on all four blocks and on a deleted expectations block; that the floor is recomputed from the vectors and is the MAXIMUM over the four arms, that clause_per_family uses each family's own floor, and that a model beating chance + 0.05 but not floor + 0.05 reads REAL_FIT_FAILS; and that equality is not brittle, because nothing is recomputed between the disk and the digest - two passes at different thread counts gave identical hashes and counts.
pre_freeze_review.why_the_gate_could_not_see_it: The same failure as 0020, one nesting level lower. The 0020 review made the gate's control substitute values into the runner's captured blocks for corpus, ext_corpus, fit_corpus and partition - but the FIT RECORDS were still overwritten wholesale, and record() replaced fit_info with {'n_iter': 100} for every arm, handing the reader exactly the value it wanted and the runner never writes. block_refills and the record environment were overwritten the same way. The provenance case was symmetric and recursive over KEY SETS and never compared a value or descended into a record's fit_info, so 58/58 stayed green.

run_record.cost: 1556.5 s wall on one launch, 1255.1 s of it fitting; the two M4 builder arms and the reproduction rung dominate. No arm reached its iteration cap.

what_it_found.but_a_hand_writable_rule_gets_most_of_it: A depth-3 decision tree fitted on the same 26346 rows reads 0.0929 on those same held-out rows. The searched model's margin over it is 0.0264 against the preregistered 0.05. That is the clause, and it fails by 908 rows.
what_it_found.content_not_budget: Both builder-matched arms read far below the real-fitted model on the real families: builder_matched 0.0671 at the same ROW budget over 19413 builder plaintexts, builder_chunk_matched 0.0638 at the same PLAINTEXT budget (1029). The rival explanation 'the fit corpus is too small to learn anything' is closed on both axes: what buys the lift is fitting on real content, not the size of the fit.
what_it_found.no_family_clears: 0 of 5 real families clear their own floor plus 0.05. py_src comes closest, short by 0.0033 (model 0.1327 against its floor 0.0860 + 0.05); rst_doc is furthest, short by 0.0373. Every family's model reading is ABOVE its own floor - by 0.0127 to 0.0467 - and none by the preregistered margin.
what_it_found.one_line: Real content DOES carry the encoder signal, and a depth-3 tree gets most of it.
what_it_found.real_content_carries_signal: 0014's searched model fitted on real content reads 0.1193 on the held-out real-family rows - 3.1 times chance, and nearly double the 0.0637 the same recipe reached on the SAME rows in 0018, when it had been fitted on the builder's generated families (4587 correct rows against 0018's 2450, a lead of 2137). The question 0018 left open - whether real files carry the signal at all - is answered yes.
what_it_found.the_bar_is_what_made_this_honest: Under the chance-based bar 0020 drafted, and which 0015 and 0018 used, 4587 correct rows against 3402 needed would have published as REAL_FIT_CLEARS. The 0020 pre-freeze review replaced it with OPERATING_RULES section 4a's floor plus a margin, arguing that a chance bar could publish a pass over a result beatable by a rule a person could write out by hand. That is exactly what the measurement turned out to be.
what_it_found.the_sister_recipes: 0014's standardised logistic L3 reads 0.1179 and 0003's incumbent M1 0.1012, against the searched model's 0.1193. Neither clears either. The searched model leads, narrowly - the opposite of 0018's ordering on these same rows, where the logistic led it.
what_it_found.the_transfer_failure_is_symmetric: builder_matched reads 0.201 on the builder's own evaluation set and 0.0671 on the real families; real_model reads 0.1193 on the real families and 0.0814 on the builder's. Each does roughly twice as well inside its own distribution as outside it. The encoder signal is real in both kinds of content and does not travel well between them.

run_record.what_this_does_not_say: It does not say real content lacks the encoder signal; it says the opposite, at 3.1 times chance. It does not revise 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017, 0018 or 0019. It is an IN-DISTRIBUTION reading on real content, not a transfer reading: the fit and scored chunks are cut from the same five pinned files. It is a bound on this recipe at this budget on these five file kinds, and the per-family table says which. It establishes no buyer, customer, user or partner, and was never capable of doing so.

what_changed_from_0020.everything_else: Unchanged: the eleven arms, the three recipes verbatim from 0014/0018, the four trivial-baseline floor arms, the two builder-matched arms, the seed, the corpora and their hashes, the floor-plus-margin clause, the per-family second clause, the scoring set, the reproduction and null controls, and every disclosure the 0020 review added.
what_changed_from_0020.measured_in_advance: The four counts were measured after 0020's refusal and before 0021 was written, from the same data with the same digest, and are banked in artifacts/pivot/builder_duplicate_chunks.json. The pre-freeze check recomputes them from the data rather than comparing the preregistration against itself.
what_changed_from_0020.one_clause: bar.nothing_scored_was_fitted kept only the counts that bear on the CLAUSE - the four fit-corpus counts, still a blanket zero and still fatal. A new clause, bar.builder_block_collisions_are_the_measured_ones, requires the three BUILDER blocks' counts to EQUAL sealed expectations rather than to be zero.
what_changed_from_0020.runner: tools/pivot/run_realfit.py now measures the plaintext-matched block's collisions too (0020's scan predated that arm), refuses on the fit block separately from the three builder blocks, and banks the sealed expectations on EVERY path including --smoke - because the mutation gate's control is built from a captured smoke artifact, and a key the runner writes only sometimes is a key the control lacks. That is the same class of defect the 0020 pre-freeze review found in the ledger.
what_changed_from_0020.why_equality_and_not_a_ceiling: A ceiling would pass a run where the count grew, which is the case that means new content crossed the boundary. Equality refuses in both directions: larger means something crossed that this preregistration did not measure, smaller means the split, the cache or the blocks are not the sealed ones.

why_this_exists.one_line: 0020 sealed this identical design, froze as chain entry 20, and refused at launch. 0021 changes one validity clause and nothing else.
why_this_exists.precedent: 0013 re-read 0012 under a corrected reader; 0019 re-read 0018 under a corrected literal. Neither edited the frozen file and neither is edited here. 0021 is a new preregistration with a new chain entry, a new reader and its own pre-freeze check.
why_this_exists.the_cause: The corpus builder emitted 9 pairs of source chunks whose carved feature rows collide - 64 identical row pairs out of 1300000 rows, 0.00492 percent. The grouped split keeps each CHUNK ID wholly on one side, but it cannot know that two different chunk ids carry the same content, so 32 of those row pairs straddle the evaluation/pool boundary, spread over 6 of the 9 chunk pairs. Only ONE pair (44496 on the evaluation side, 48016 on the pool side, 26 of 26 rows identical) lands inside the blocks 0020 fits on, and it produces every collision the runner refused on: 8 rows of the 100000-row reproduction block and 2 of the 26346-row builder-matched block. NONE of the 9 pairs involves the extension corpus, and 0020's real-content fit corpus has zero rows byte-identical to any scored row, so the clause's own disjointness is intact. What the refusal caught is a property of the BUILDER's corpus, inherited unmeasured by every preregistration that has fitted on this pool and scored on this evaluation set since 0003 - including the 0.1965 reproduction rung 0020 uses as its control.
why_this_exists.the_defect_in_0020: The frozen condition is right for the arm that carries the clause and too strict for the two builder control arms. 'Nothing scored was fitted' is a statement about the FIT corpus; applying it unchanged to the reproduction rung and the builder-matched block asks 0003's eight-year-old pool to have a property the corpus builder never gave it, and makes 0020 unable to run for a reason that cannot touch its own answer. The preregistration says the rival explanation is 'closed by construction'; for the fit corpus it is, and the construction proves it with a measured zero. For the builder blocks the construction refuses instead.
why_this_exists.what_0020_did: Exit 3 at 2026-09-16T08:37:20Z, 7 seconds after launch, before any checkpoint existed, on its own preregistered condition that no fit-block, repro-block or matched-block row may be byte-identical to a scored row. fit was 0; repro was 8 and matched was 2. Filed in artifacts/pivot/engineering_log_0020.json under `refusal`, with the run's stdout banked at artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096_refusal.log. No arm was fitted and nothing was scored.
